channel.title: Pier & Point · UCSF Valley Center for Vision
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for UCSF Valley Center for Vision (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · UCSF Valley Center for Vision: The block 33 record said its identification as UCSF's Valley Center for Vision had no published source. UCSF's June 2025 CAC presentation (map updated December 2024) labels block 33 'VALLEY CENTER FOR VISION (33)', so the summary, caveat and map notes now cite it, along with OCII's 2019 Land Use Map. Because UCSF's map places the name on block 33, between Third St and Illinois St, the separate 490/499 Illinois St record east of Illinois St may be the one that is mislabelled; that record has not been changed and the question remains open. The record's own mapping log is now labelled as this project's narrative, the NAIP aerial credit names the USDA Farm Production and Conservation Business Center, and the Wikimedia aerial credit names only the Commons username Firstcultural.
